# Program mum-home-foundation-v2 (version 2026-11-03)

Default status: `assessment_pending`. The personal workout flow stays pending until a GP or physiotherapist has assessed the person's back history (and anything the screening flags) and confirmed the movements and progression are appropriate under that advice.

> These starter counts, progression checkpoints and UX choices are **conservative product proposals, not a medically validated prescription** for any individual. Changes require an explicit content revision by the owner with appropriate professional guidance.

## Schedule, warm-up, pace and rest

- Default strengthening days: Tuesday and Friday. The person may change days, keeping at least one full non-strength day between them (the app allows exactly two days a week).
- Warm-up: 2 minutes of comfortable easy walking around the house, only if appropriate and not symptom-provoking.
- Exercise order: Chair sit-to-stand, Wall press-up, Supported heel raise, Supported side leg lift.
- Pace: about two seconds up/out and two seconds down/back, natural breathing. The app never forces a rhythm or counts reps from elapsed time.
- Rest: 60 seconds between sets and exercises, with unlimited extension; 30–60 seconds to change sides in leg lifts.
- First session about 8–12 minutes including learning/rest; later about 15–20 minutes. No deadline.
- Effort: several repetitions should still feel possible at the end. No straining, failure work, maximal or timed tests.
- Added load: 0 kg at every stage. No loaded exercises.

## The eight stages (sets × repetitions)

| Stage | Chair sit-to-stand | Wall press-up | Supported heel raise | Supported side leg lift |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 × 5 | 1 × 5 | 1 × 5 | 1 × 5 each side |
| 2 | 1 × 8 | 1 × 8 | 1 × 8 | 1 × 8 each side |
| 3 | 2 × 8 | 1 × 8 | 1 × 8 | 1 × 8 each side |
| 4 | 2 × 8 | 2 × 8 | 1 × 8 | 1 × 8 each side |
| 5 | 2 × 8 | 2 × 8 | 2 × 8 | 1 × 8 each side |
| 6 | 2 × 8 | 2 × 8 | 2 × 8 | 2 × 8 each side |
| 7 | 2 × 10 | 2 × 10 | 2 × 10 | 2 × 10 each side |
| 8 | Hold 2 × 10 | Hold 2 × 10 | Hold 2 × 10 | Hold 2 × 10 each side |

Each stage needs at least 2 completed full sessions plus comfortable next-day responses, and the person must actively choose to advance (default: "Keep this amount / 保持这个量"). Stages are not calendar weeks. Stage 8 is maintenance plus a program-review invitation — there is no stage 9 and no weight increase.

## Tiny session

- Chair sit-to-stand: 1 × 3
- Wall press-up: 1 × 3
- At least 60 seconds rest between the two movements. Counts for progression: no.

## Exact exercise instructions (as supplied)

### Chair sit-to-stand / 坐站练习

- Technique: Stable armless chair against wall, feet planted hip-width apart, comfortable forward lean, stand smoothly and sit slowly. Hands on thighs may help; no stacked cushions. One stand plus return to sitting = one rep.
- Benefit: Practice getting up; work thighs and hips. 练习起身，让大腿和臀部更有力。
- If it is not suitable: Stop and review; no AI-selected replacement.

### Wall press-up / 扶墙推起

- Technique: Hands around chest height, initially close enough to be easy. Bend elbows through a comfortable range, push back with trunk controlled. One bend-and-push-back = one rep.
- Benefit: Practice pushing; work chest and arms. 练习推的力量，让胸部和手臂更有力。
- If it is not suitable: Stop/review; no automatic floor or counter progression.

### Supported heel raise / 扶稳提踵

- Technique: Both hands on fixed counter, both heels rise comfortably and lower slowly. Retain support, no step edge or single-leg test. Both heels up/down = one rep.
- Benefit: Work calves for walking/standing. 练习小腿发力，支持走路和站立。
- If it is not suitable: Stop/review; no undemonstrated seated substitution.

### Supported side leg lift / 扶稳侧抬腿

- Technique: Hold fixed counter, toes forward, small sideways lift and controlled return without leaning or twisting. One out-and-return on one leg = one rep.
- Benefit: Work side-of-hip muscles for movement control. 练习髋部侧面的肌肉，帮助控制站立和移动。
- If it is not suitable: Stop/review rather than stretching through symptoms.

## Coverage limitation

This four-movement on-ramp omits substantial pulling and posterior-chain training, so it is **not** a complete all-major-muscle-groups program. A later review (at Stage 8, or earlier) should select suitable additional patterns and resistance with appropriate professional help. The app never fills the gap automatically (no rows, carries, curls or weights).
